`pain.001.001.09.xsd` is the unchanged ISO 20022 schema, downloaded for
NovaKind's SEPA tests on 2026-11-03 and copied here byte for byte.

Source: https://www.iso20022.org/sites/default/files/documents/messages/pain/schemas/pain.001.001.09.xsd

SHA-256: `de038b373e47b0077b1832ddd81f4b2f1eb25d35721f62da1e38b7f5a09fda24`.

ISO's repository IPR policy grants a non-exclusive, royalty-free license to
use published information: https://www.iso20022.org/intellectual-property-rights

`pain09.xml` is synthetic test data adapted from NovaKind's V03 compatibility
golden to the V09 namespace, execution-date choice and BICFI field. It is not a
bank submission. Schema validation does not prove any bank's additional profile.
Tests never fetch schemas, resolve external entities or submit payments.
